material.acceptance_criteria: A publish_on_origin of a submodule path yields a gitlink update (mode 160000) at the submodule HEAD, and a dry run reports the gitlink sha, never a deletion.
material.commit_comment: gm-mcp fix on origin main: a23381f5 (CI 6/6 green), bundle ced00cb (green). Cause triage-verbs.js:421 force-removed a gitlink whose checkout is a directory.
material.description: Publishing paths:["js/client/vendor/wireweave"] (a gitlink) with repo_dir /workspace/oscraft produced fb83995a, whose only change is 'removed js/client/vendor/wireweave'; the submodule entry vanished from the parent tree on origin main. Repaired by b73c0673 (Git API tree entry mode 160000 at 2686246e). Fix the gm publish route (/workspace/gm) so a gitlink path publishes the pinned sha, and refuse a publish whose diff deletes a gitlink.
material.subject: publish_on_origin with a submodule path deletes the gitlink on origin main
material.witness: gm-mcp/src/triage-verbs.js:406-446 (gitlinkOf and the lane pin branch); witness dry-run commit 14421f0c has an empty diff vs origin/main, so js/client/vendor/wireweave stays 160000 2686246e; negative control on served 0.2.281 showed '1 -'
